chunks: What the Shaykh, may Allah Ta'ala support him, informed me of, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan and Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Fudayl ibn 'Uthman, from Abu 'Ubaydah al-Hadhdha', who said:

I performed wudu for Abu Ja'far عليه السلام at Jam', and he had urinated. So I handed him water and he performed istinja'. Then he took a handful and washed his face with it, and a handful with which he washed his right forearm, and a handful with which he washed his left forearm. Then he wiped his head and his feet with the remaining moisture.
ai.seo_question: How did Abu Ja'far عليه السلام perform wudu according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the manner of the wudu of Abu Ja'far عليه السلام after relieving himself. It outlines washing the face and both forearms with separate handfuls of water, then wiping the head and feet with the remaining moisture, making it significant for rulings of ritual purity and wudu.
